mappings.capability: reusable uploaded and generated file library

mappings.improvement: Expose availability and materialization state explicitly; never invent a local path from a connector reference.

mappings.capability: typed operation catalog and schema discovery
mappings.improvement: Permit capability schemas to be discovered incrementally so a caller need not load every operation at once.
Advertise observe, draft, simulate, mutate, publish, destructive and external-side-effect classes as mechanical metadata.

mappings.capability: external permission preservation and confirmation policy
mappings.improvement: Separate external account access from the local rule deciding when confirmation is required.

mappings.capability: large result handles with incremental access
mappings.improvement: Retain large results behind stable references that support paging, searching and bounded reads.
A card, table, chart or preview is a View over the same underlying record and never becomes its authority.

mappings.capability: exact flexible and condition timing modes
mappings.improvement: Retain whether a schedule is exact, windowed or condition-dependent instead of flattening all schedules into one timer.

mappings.capability: exact revision preconditions and optimistic concurrency
mappings.improvement: Fail closed when the exact target revision, branch head or draft version moved.

mappings.capability: read draft simulate execute verify lifecycle
distinct failure decline cancellation and not-run states
mappings.improvement: Do not collapse user denial, policy rejection, execution failure, cancellation and missing execution into one generic error.

mappings.boundary: Hunter, Sergeant or another caller chooses the query, relevance and packet contents.
Ptah reports compatible operations and availability; the caller chooses which capability serves the job.
Ptah can run a submitted merge Recipe but does not decide which conclusion is correct.
Ptah may block execution until a configured decision record exists; the human or approval application makes the decision.
Acceptance labels and promotion decisions are caller-owned records.
The caller supplies the work, purpose and desired outcome.

mappings.capability: hidden provider memory as canonical state
mappings.reason: Provider-private state cannot replace inspectable caller-owned records.
Every external and local operation remains bounded by configured access and exact operation metadata.

mappings.capability: chat transcript as sole operational database
mappings.reason: Operational state must survive independently as typed records, Objects, Activities and Receipts.
References, mounts and copied bytes require visibly different states and provenance.
A final Receipt or independently checked post-condition is required to claim the effect.
Views are replaceable renderings over underlying typed state.

conclusion: The deeper workspace study improves Ptah profile composition and application contracts without adding a Core entity or reopening WP01-WP14.
